snippet.title: Stone Eternal | TRAILER | First-Person Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Experience this horrifying first person experience from ROBOTBOY. Available 19th November 2025. r0b0tb0y.itch.io/stone-eternal (page goes live 19th November)

"Every map marked this town as empty, forgotten, erased. And yet, the statues remain.

Nearby villagers still speak of this town in hushed tones. They warn travellers never to step through its streets once darkness falls.

Some claim those who lived here made a pact during the war, trading their souls for eternal life.

You travel here in search of truth…"
